item.name: Get resources that are related to a resource identified by IRI

request.name: Get resources that are related to a resource identified by IRI

description.content: If a resource A is related to resource B and C, this endpoint will return B and C. See request body for further filtering options.

query.description: (Required) Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) of the resource. You can find the IRI in the Technical Reference section under the Settings tab on the resource’s catalog page.

Return additional information about the resource. For example, if the resource is in a collection, the collection IRI will be returned by default. If hydration is enabled, the collection's title and description will also be returned.
A token supplied by the previous response to retrieve the next page of results

variable.description:
(Required) User name and unique identifier of the user or organization a resource belongs to.
